concept.title: Age or school stage
concept.shortdesc: Services for people defined by a minimum age, a young age or stage, or attendance at a particular school.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Services for older people, set by a minimum age of around 50 to 65.
: Services open to people at or above a minimum age of 16.
: Services open to adults, set by a minimum age of 18 (or 17), including phrases like adults only.
: Services for young children defined by their age or by their nursery or school stage, such as babies, toddlers, pre-schoolers and primary pupils.
: Services limited to children or students who attend a named school or type of school.
